title: Wall Street's AI Jitters Meet an Oil Spike
en: Wall Street suffered its worst technology selloff in months on Thursday as anxiety over artificial-intelligence spending collided with a fresh jump in oil prices. The Nasdaq Composite fell 2.60% to 26,008.86, its steepest daily drop since June, while the S&P 500 lost 1.21% to 7,663.43 and the Dow edged up 0.02%. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index slid about 6.7%. Meta Platforms dropped nearly 7% despite beating revenue forecasts, after flagging its first cash outflow in more than a decade to fund AI expansion. Advanced Micro Devices fell more than 8% and Nvidia 4.4%. Brent crude settled 4% higher at $113.17 a barrel following reports of US-Israel strike plans against Iran and Houthi attacks on Saudi facilities, while the 10-year Treasury yield fell about 17 basis points as investors sought safety.
zh: 周四华尔街遭遇数月来最惨烈的科技股抛售，对人工智能支出的担忧与油价新一轮跳涨叠加共振。纳斯达克综合指数跌2.60%至26008.86点，创6月以来最大单日跌幅；标普500指数跌1.21%至7663.43点，道指微涨0.02%。费城半导体指数下挫约6.7%。Meta尽管营收超预期仍跌近7%，此前该公司提示将出现十余年来首次现金净流出以支撑AI扩张。AMD跌超8%，英伟达跌4.4%。受美以或打击伊朗、胡塞武装袭击沙特设施的报道推动，布伦特原油收涨4%至每桶113.17美元；与此同时投资者转向避险，10年期美债收益率下行约17个基点。
vocab: adj. 最大幅度的，最急剧的

title: Bank of Korea Pauses After Back-to-Back Hikes
en: The Bank of Korea left its benchmark seven-day repurchase rate unchanged at 3.00% on Thursday, pausing after quarter-point increases in July and August that were its first consecutive hikes in more than three years. All 34 analysts in a Reuters poll had forecast the hold. The board said growth this year and next will be considerably stronger than its August projections of 3.3% and 2.9%, lifted by semiconductor exports that pushed January-September shipments past $800 billion for the first time. Headline inflation eased to 2.9% in September from 3.1% in August but stays above the 2% target, and home prices in Seoul and its surrounding areas are accelerating again. Officials kept the door open to further tightening, saying they will judge the timing and pace of future increases.
zh: 韩国银行周四将基准7天回购利率维持在3.00%不变，在此前7月和8月连续两次各加息25个基点后按下暂停键——这是该行三年多来首次连续加息。路透调查的34位分析师全部预测此次按兵不动。委员会表示，在半导体出口拉动下，今明两年经济增速将明显高于8月预测的3.3%和2.9%；1至9月出口额史上首次突破8000亿美元。9月总体通胀率由8月的3.1%回落至2.9%，但仍高于2%目标，首尔及周边地区房价涨幅再度加快。官方保留了进一步紧缩的空间，称将判断未来加息的时点与节奏。

title: Gulf on Edge as Strike Plans and Houthi Attacks Pile Up
en: Tensions across the Middle East escalated again this week. The US and Israeli militaries have drawn up plans for a short but intense strike on Iran after next month's US midterm elections, according to officials familiar with the matter, with possible targets including energy infrastructure, nuclear sites and missile and drone depots. President Trump said Washington is not negotiating with Tehran and that something will happen soon. Iran's parliament speaker warned that a war would impose bitter costs on Washington, while Tehran said it prefers diplomacy but retains the means to respond. Meanwhile Yemen's Houthi movement said it carried out four operations against Saudi Arabia within 48 hours, hitting targets including a defence ministry building, King Fahd International Airport and an Aramco facility. Washington has ordered non-emergency staff and their families to leave Saudi Arabia.
zh: 本周中东紧张局势再度升级。据知情官员透露，美国和以色列军方已拟定在下月美国中期选举结束后对伊朗发动一场短促而高强度打击的计划，可能目标包括能源基础设施、核设施以及导弹和无人机仓库。特朗普称华盛顿并未与德黑兰谈判，并表示很快就会有事发生。伊朗议长警告，一旦开战美国将付出苦涩代价；伊方同时表示更倾向外交途径，但保留应对手段。另一方面，也门胡塞武装称48小时内对沙特实施四次行动，打击目标包括国防部大楼、法赫德国王国际机场和一处阿美设施。美国已下令驻沙特的非紧急政府雇员及家属撤离。

title: Moscow Hit by Record Drone Barrage as Peace Signals Multiply
en: Moscow came under its largest drone attack of the war this week, Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said, with 630 unmanned aircraft launched against the region overnight and 163 intercepted as they approached the city. Russia's defence ministry separately reported destroying 808 Ukrainian fixed-wing drones over more than ten regions and the Black Sea. The strikes came as diplomacy picked up: President Putin told US envoy Steve Witkoff that Moscow is prepared to restart trilateral Russian-American-Ukrainian talks in mid-November, with Abu Dhabi a possible venue, though the Kremlin has yet to name its delegation. Ukraine's President Zelensky said Kyiv supports launching the talks soon. Russia and Ukraine also exchanged the remains of 252 and 25 soldiers in Belarus.
zh: 莫斯科市市长索比亚宁表示，本周莫斯科遭遇开战以来最大规模无人机袭击：一夜之间共有630架无人机袭击莫斯科地区，其中163架在逼近市区时被拦截。俄国防部另行通报，同期在十余个地区及黑海上空共摧毁808架乌克兰固定翼无人机。袭击发生之际外交接触正在升温：普京总统告诉美国特使威特科夫，俄方准备于11月中旬重启俄美乌三方会谈，阿布扎比可能是会谈地点，但克里姆林宫尚未确定代表团人选。乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示基辅支持尽快启动会谈。俄乌双方还在白俄罗斯交换了252具和25具阵亡军人遗体。

title: French Yields Top US as Riots Roll Into a Second Week
en: France's borrowing costs broke through a symbolic ceiling this week, with the 10-year government bond yield climbing above 5% and rising above its US counterpart for the first time in 13 years. Five-year credit default swaps on French debt pushed past 100 basis points, and the gap over German bunds briefly widened to about 175 basis points, the most since the 2011 euro-area debt crisis. The move reflects investor unease over fiscal sustainability after nationwide protests over living costs, fuel prices and education spilled into rioting. Authorities extended a curfew in central Paris until 6am on Sunday, banned a weekend rally in Lyon, and closed the Louvre and the Musee d'Orsay as a precaution. More than 2,000 people have been detained.
zh: 本周法国融资成本突破了一个具有象征意义的上限：10年期国债收益率升破5%，并13年来首次高于同期限美国国债。法国5年期信用违约互换价格突破100个基点，与德国国债的利差一度扩大至约175个基点，为2011年欧元区债务危机以来最高。这一走势反映出投资者对财政可持续性的担忧——此前围绕生活成本、燃油价格和教育议题的全国抗议已演变为骚乱。当局将巴黎市中心宵禁延长至周日早上6点，禁止里昂周末集会，并出于防范关闭卢浮宫与奥赛博物馆。目前已有两千多人被拘留。

title: Huawei's Supernode and DeepSeek's Mega-Round
en: China's artificial-intelligence hardware push produced two notable headlines this week. Huawei unveiled what it called its first NPO supernode, with a single Ascend 960 supernode linking 4,096 neural processing units at round-trip latency as low as two microseconds; the company said more than 1,000 supernodes are already deployed across over 370 customers. Separately, DeepSeek raised roughly 100 billion yuan, about $15 billion, in its latest funding round with Tencent and CATL among the investors, one of the largest financings in Chinese history. Abroad, Google's tensor processing units began running production AI workloads inside Meta's data centres, the first time the chips have been supplied to an outside customer, after PyTorch-native support arrived in the SGLang and vLLM inference engines.
zh: 本周中国人工智能硬件推进出现两条引人注目的消息。华为发布其称为首款的NPO超节点，单个昇腾960超节点可互联4096颗神经网络处理器，往返时延低至2微秒；公司称昇腾超节点已部署1000多套、覆盖370多家客户。另一边，DeepSeek在最新一轮融资中筹集约1000亿元人民币（约150亿美元），腾讯与宁德时代参投，为中国有史以来规模最大的融资之一。海外方面，在SGLang和vLLM两款推理引擎完成PyTorch原生适配后，谷歌张量处理单元开始在Meta数据中心承担生产环境AI负载，这是该芯片首次向外部客户供货。
